Title: [LSJ] Question: Tariq + master discipline card + Soul Gem

Messages.Author: Noah
Messages.Body:
Of course I did the obligatory search on this but was unable to come up with
an exact similar circumstance.

Tariq has the soul gem and a master discipline card, he gets burned and
another Tariq is drawn from the crypt. What happens?

-Noah Godwin, (Self Proclaimed) Archbishop of Durham....

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Noah wrote:
>
> Of course I did the obligatory search on this but was unable to come up with
> an exact similar circumstance.
>
> Tariq has the soul gem and a master discipline card, he gets burned and
> another Tariq is drawn from the crypt. What happens?

The vampire drawn from the crypt has capacity 7, which makes him older
than the vampire being burned (whose capacity is 5), so the vampire
drawn is placed in the uncontrolled region and the Gem is burned.
